name: Heat Kernel Textures (HKTex)
definition: An intrinsic, UV-free texture representation using anisotropic heat kernels as geodesic equivalents to Gaussians, defined on any manifold surface discretised as a triangular mesh. It eliminates UV unwrapping, wasted UV space, seams, distortions, and vertex duplication.
summary: Heat Kernel Textures is an intrinsic, UV-free texture representation using anisotropic heat kernels that conform to manifold surfaces, eliminating UV mapping artifacts.
